description: This file implements the core logic of an autonomous agent service in Dart for a Flutter app. It includes definition of the AgentService class, error handling, and tool execution functionalities, managing the interaction flow between user input, AI model responses, and environment tools.

classes.name: AgentException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling specific agent error types.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: Main class providing agent functionalities for solving tasks through AI and tools, managing conversation flow and actions.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the agent state, message history, and activity status.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Executes the agent loop with provided user input, managing message exchanges, actions, and observations.

methods.name: _addStep
methods.description: Adds a new step to the agent's step list and triggers UI update.

methods.name: _setupTools
methods.description: Initializes available environment tools for the agent to use.

methods.name: _executeAction
methods.description: Parses and executes an action command using the appropriate tool.

methods.name: _parseAction
methods.description: Parses the action string into tool name and arguments.

methods.name: _parseArguments
methods.description: Converts a string of comma-separated arguments into a list.

methods.name: _extractContent
methods.description: Extracts XML-tagged content from model responses.

methods.name: _generateSystemPrompt
methods.description: Creates the initial system prompt instructing the agent on the task and format.
